newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico says ups dollar put option amount.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico says ups dollar put option amount.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday it will raise the amount of dollar put options it sells each month to $200 million compared to $130 million auctioned during August.

"In view of the reaction to the plan and the success of the first auction of options, the Foreign Exchange Comission has decided to increase, to $200 million, the amount of options on offer," Banco de Mexico said in a statement.
It said the next auction will be held on Friday, August 30. Buyers of the options will have a month to exercise their options.
The Foreign Exchange Comission is made up of officials of the central bank and the Finance Ministry.
The option plan is designed to help the central bank build reserves during times of peso strength.
During August, all $130 million of the options were exercised by buyers and the central bank was able to boost its level of reserves.
